segments.text: Forget 21 days. One study estimated habits take 18 to 254.
96 volunteers repeated one daily behaviour for 12 weeks, and rated how automatic it felt.
Then a model estimated when each person would level off. The spread was huge.
So if it still feels hard on day 22, you're not failing.
And missing one day did not materially affect the habit.
Pick one action, tie it to the same moment each day, and don't judge it at three weeks.
Try it today: pick one habit, and mark day one.
